result.summary: DeepSeek-V3 是一个总参数 671B、每 token 激活 37B 的 MoE 语言模型，沿用 MLA 与 DeepSeekMoE 架构，并引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略和多 token 预测训练目标 [abstract]。模型在 14.8 万亿 token 上预训练，随后经过 SFT 与 RL 阶段 [abstract]。综合评测显示其优于其他开源模型，性能可与领先闭源模型相比 [abstract]，完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时，且训练过程未出现不可恢复的 loss spike 或回滚 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在同时追求强模型性能与经济成本，为此在架构上继续采用 MLA 以实现高效推理、采用 DeepSeekMoE 以实现低成本训练 [S1.p2]。在此基础上，论文还试图通过无辅助损失的负载均衡策略减少为鼓励负载均衡而对模型性能造成的不利影响，并采用多 token 预测训练目标提升评测基准上的整体表现 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: With a forward-looking perspective, we consistently strive for strong model performance and economical costs.
DeepSeek-V3 still adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for efficient inference and DeepSeekMoE for cost-effective training.
DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing, with the aim of minimizing the adverse impact on model performance
DeepSeek-V3 employs a multi-token prediction training objective, which we have observed to enhance the overall performance on evaluation benchmarks.

method.text: DeepSeek-V3 的基本架构仍处于 Transformer 框架内，采用经 DeepSeek-V2 验证的 MLA 与 DeepSeekMoE，并额外引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略以缓解负载均衡带来的性能退化 [S2.SS1.p1]。训练方面，论文设计了 FP8 混合精度训练框架，并首次在超大规模模型上验证 FP8 训练的可行性与有效性 [S1.p9]；同时通过算法、框架与硬件协同设计克服跨节点 MoE 训练的通信瓶颈，实现近乎完全的计算-通信重叠 [S1.p9]。此外，论文设计了 DualPipe 流水线并行算法，重叠前向与反向的计算-通信阶段并减少流水线气泡 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]，还提出细粒度量化方法以缓解特征离群值导致的量化误差 [S3.F7]。

evidence.quote: The basic architecture of DeepSeek-V3 is still within the Transformer framework.
DeepSeek-V3 also adopts MLA and DeepSeekMoE, which have been thoroughly validated by DeepSeek-V2.
we additionally introduce an auxiliary-loss-free load balancing strategy for DeepSeekMoE to mitigate the performance degradation
We design an FP8 mixed precision training framework and, for the first time, validate the feasibility and effectiveness of FP8 training on an extremely large-scale model.
we overcome the communication bottleneck in cross-node MoE training, achieving near-full computation-communication overlap.
we design an innovative pipeline parallelism algorithm called DualPipe, which not only accelerates model training by effectively overlapping forward and backward computation-communication phases
We propose a fine-grained quantization method to mitigate quantization errors caused by feature outliers

experiments.text: DeepSeek-V3 在 14.8 万亿 token 上进行预训练，随后进行 SFT 与 RL 阶段 [abstract]。基础模型在多语言语料上预训练，以英文和中文为主，因此主要在英文、中文以及一个多语言基准上评测，评测基于其 HAI-LLM 框架内的内部评测框架 [S4.SS4.SSS1.p1]。基础模型与 DeepSeek-V2-Base、Qwen2.5 72B Base、LLaMA-3.1 405B Base 在相同评测设置下比较 [S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。评测覆盖 MMLU、MMLU-Pro、GPQA、DROP、SimpleQA、LiveCodeBench、MATH-500、Arena-Hard、RewardBench 等基准，并采用 simple-evals 提示、Zero-Eval 格式、CoT 与非 CoT 方法等具体配置 [S5.SS3.SSS1.Px3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8 trillion diverse and high-quality tokens, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning stages
The base model of DeepSeek-V3 is pretrained on a multilingual corpus with English and Chinese constituting the majority
Our evaluation is based on our internal evaluation framework integrated in our HAI-LLM framework.
we compare the base model of DeepSeek-V3 with the state-of-the-art open-source base models, including DeepSeek-V2-Base (our previous release), Qwen2.5 72B Base, and LLaMA-3.1 405B Base.
We evaluate all these models with our internal evaluation framework, and ensure that they share the same evaluation setting.
For standard benchmarks including MMLU, DROP, GPQA, and SimpleQA, we adopt the evaluation prompts from the simple-evals framework
We use CoT and non-CoT methods to evaluate model performance on LiveCodeBench

findings.text: 综合评测显示 DeepSeek-V3 优于其他开源模型，性能可与领先闭源模型相比 [abstract]。基础模型在多数基准上超过 LLaMA-3.1 405B Base，全面优于 DeepSeek-V2-Base 和 Qwen2.5 72B Base，基本成为最强开源模型 [S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。在知识类基准上，DeepSeek-V3 在 MMLU 得 88.5、MMLU-Pro 得 75.9、GPQA 得 59.1，优于所有其他开源模型，与 GPT-4o 和 Claude-Sonnet-3.5 等领先闭源模型相当 [S1.p10]。在数学相关基准上，DeepSeek-V3 在所有非长 CoT 开源与闭源模型中达到 state-of-the-art，并在 MATH-500 等特定基准上超过 o1-preview [S1.p10]。在 Arena-Hard 上，DeepSeek-V3 对基线 GPT-4-0314 取得超过 86% 的胜率，成为首个在该基准上超过 85% 的开源模型 [S5.SS3.SSS3.p1]。训练成本方面，完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时，预训练在 14.8T token 上仅耗 2.664M H800 GPU 小时 [abstract][S1.p9]。

evidence.quote: Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models.
DeepSeek-V3-Base comprehensively outperforms DeepSeek-V2-Base and Qwen2.5 72B Base, and surpasses LLaMA-3.1 405B Base in the majority of benchmarks
DeepSeek-V3 outperforms all other open-source models, achieving 88.5 on MMLU, 75.9 on MMLU-Pro, and 59.1 on GPQA.
Its performance is comparable to leading closed-source models like GPT-4o and Claude-Sonnet-3.5
DeepSeek-V3 achieves state-of-the-art performance on math-related benchmarks among all non-long-CoT open-source and closed-source models.
it even outperforms o1-preview on specific benchmarks, such as MATH-500
DeepSeek-V3 achieves an impressive win rate of over 86% against the baseline GPT-4-0314
DeepSeek-V3 achieves a groundbreaking milestone as the first open-source model to surpass 85% on the Arena-Hard benchmark.
DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.
At an economical cost of only 2.664M H800 GPU hours, we complete the pre-training of DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T tokens

limitations.text: 作者承认 DeepSeek-V3 在部署方面存在局限：为保证高效推理，推荐部署单元相对较大，可能给小型团队带来负担 [S6.p2]。其次，尽管其部署策略已实现超过 DeepSeek-V2 两倍的端到端生成速度，仍有进一步提升的空间 [S6.p2]。作者表示这些局限有望随更先进硬件的发展自然得到解决 [S6.p2]。此外，蒸馏虽带来更好性能，但也大幅增加平均响应长度，为平衡准确率与计算效率需谨慎选择设置 [S5.SS4.SSS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
there still remains potential for further enhancement.
these limitations are expected to be naturally addressed with the development of more advanced hardware.
the distillation leads to better performance but also substantially increases the average response length.
